post.summary: Create a category, at most 4 levels deep

Hide a product; products are never deleted

Add a variant naming one value of every option

patch.summary: Change a variant's price or status

Read the profile; the first call creates it from the token

get.summary: Read an address

put.summary: Apply a coupon, replacing any other

delete.summary: Remove a line; removing a line that is not there changes nothing

post.summary: Merge the guest cart named by Cart-Token into this cart, after signing in

List the caller's orders, newest first

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

202.description: The order, CANCELLING or already CANCELLED

post.summary: Cancel an order before it ships; a paid order is refunded

202.description: The order; it moves on once the payment's outcome is known

post.summary: Check the payment now, on returning from the hosted checkout, rather than waiting for the gateway's webhook; repeats are harmless

get.summary: Browse active products, newest first, or search them by relevance with q
An active product with its active variants and images
States and union territories with their GST state codes
Read any order, with its customer id

Book a failed booking again, with a new 24-hour budget

Mark a booked shipment packed

get.summary: List stock items in SKU order
Read a SKU's stock levels
